text:
sam: Heads-up — after the GPU spot reclaim around 09:12 we saw a bunch of inference pods in us-west-edge fail with TCP RSTs when calling the model-cache headless svc. DNS resolves fine but connections drop immediately.
ada: Same, noticed increased 502s on the ingest path and a flurry of conntrack entries. Might be stale endpoints from drained nodes.
kai: Can you paste the endpointslice listing for that headless svc? I want to see if slices still reference gone nodes.
sam: Ran this:```kubectl get endpointslice -n prod -l kubernetes.io/service-name=headless-model-cache -o wide```Output shows 6 slices, but two have endpoints with IPs for terminated-spot nodes (ready=false entries). Noticed the controller hasn't pruned them.
leah: We switched kube-proxy to iptables on those nodes last month; iptables + stale endpoints + conntrack can yield immediate RSTs if the backend IP disappears without conntrack cleanup.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident labeled "edge-headless-conn-reset" created by sam at 1992345678. Paging infra oncall.
sam: Quick debug: `kubectl exec -n prod -c nslookup model-cache-xyz -- nslookup headless-model-cache` returns the SRV/A records ok. `curl --resolve "headless-model-cache.prod.svc.cluster.local:8080:10.10.45.12" http://headless-model-cache:8080/health` -> RST. 10.10.45.12 is a drained node IP.
kai: If endpointslice controller lags during scale events we can end up with headless svc mapping to IPs not accepting traffic. Two mitigation paths: (1) force endpointslice reconciliation (delete controller pod or POST to its metrics/reconcile endpoint), (2) trigger conntrack cleanup on some nodes.
ada: I'm leaning to add a short-lived job to scrub conntrack for IPs in terminated nodes as a stopgap. But that feels risky.
leah: Agree. Also check kube-proxy metrics: `kubeproxy_sync_errors_total` was spiking in the window. If kube-proxy failed to remove iptables rules when the endpoint removed, conntrack will route to dead IP and nat will RST.
infra-bot: Autoscaler event: 6 GPU spot nodes preempted between 09:10-09:13 (ids: spot-uw1-07..12).
sam: Action plan: 1) reconcile endpointslices + bump controller log level to see why it missed pruning; 2) drain/restart kube-proxy on a small subset (canary) to force rule reconciliation; 3) short-lived conntrack scrub script only after step 1/2 if RSTs persist. Anyone object? :thinking_face:
kai: +1. I'll take steps 1 & 2. I'll grab a canary node set in us-west-edge and restart kube-proxy there.
nada: I'll prototype the conntrack scrub script and make it gated by an annotation so we can opt-in per-node.
leah: I'll add a dashboard widget to show endpointslice age vs pod termination timestamps so this is easier to detect next time.
sam: Thanks. We'll update the incident with outcomes. If you find any reproducible sequence, paste it here. :thumbsup:
